dialogue: Find me floor lamps with bronze finish for living room, and price lower than 280.00 dollars
I'd like an arc floor lamp with a drum shade. And lower the price range
Prefer a plain white or neutral linen drum shade, not patterned.
A clean white glass shade is fine too, just not patterned. But I prefer the lower price
agent_final_statement: This $65.34 arc floor lamp has a blackened bronze finish and a clean white milk-glass shade with no indicated pattern. It is well below the $280 maximum and strongly satisfies the preference for a lower price.

agent_product.title: Henn&Hart Modern Arc Floor Lamp with White Milk Glass Shade in Blackened Bronze,62'',FL0962
agent_product.product_category: Tools & Home Improvement › Lighting & Ceiling Fans › Lamps & Shades › Floor Lamps
agent_product.description: A classic arc floor lamp takes a whimsical turn with the soft gem shape of this fixture’s glass shade. Keep it contemporary with clear glass or add a touch of retro flair with a white milk glass shade. Its neutral metallic finish blend easily into any color scheme.
bullet_points: Handcrafted finish is applied to the steel base.
Paired with a rounded gem-shaped globe shade.
The shade is made of white milk glass.
Rated for one 100W incandescent bulb; 9W LED bulb, 23W fluorescent (CFL) bulb, or 9W self-ballasted LED bulb. E26-base bulb.
